book.lavagenesis.journal.end.1:
One day the sea will part around a mountain taller than any other on this world, measured from the abyss to its smoking crown.

That mountain is you.

Now go. Burn.
book.lavagenesis.journal.heat.1:
Heat is your life. While you glow, you live.

Water and rain steal it in hissing steam. A tiny ember cools in moments; a seamount hardly notices the sea.
book.lavagenesis.journal.heat.2:
Lava, magma, fire and your own vent warm you again.

When the heat bar fades to grey you begin to set like stone: first slow, then cracking. Find lava. Quickly.
book.lavagenesis.journal.intro.1:
You were not born. You were released.

Far below the waves a hotspot breathes, and its breath is you: one spark of lava in the throat of a drowned volcano.
book.lavagenesis.journal.intro.2:
You are not someone who lives beside a volcano.

You are the volcano.

All you melt, drink and pour out becomes you, until the sea itself must make room.
book.lavagenesis.journal.intro.3:
The panel at the top left of your sight is your body: stage, mass, heat, pressure, land, and what the next stage still asks of you.

Press %s to shrink or hide it.
book.lavagenesis.journal.islands.1: Land only counts while it stands above the waves. Your vents measure the island around them: every column topped with volcanic rock at or above sea level.
book.lavagenesis.journal.islands.2: Black sand, basalt and pillow lava, ash and volcanic soil, and the ferns, ohia and palms that come later all count. Ordinary stone, sand and dirt do not.
book.lavagenesis.journal.islands.3: Your vents on one landmass make one island. For a new island, cross open water and raise a new vent there. Far islands are remembered when you leave.
book.lavagenesis.journal.mass.1: Mass is how much magma you are: the measure of your growth. Every stage asks for more, and the top bar of your panel shows how close you are.
book.lavagenesis.journal.mass.2:
Gather it like this:

- melt stone with Flare: +1
- sneak in lava to drink a source: +3
- swallow a magma block: +4
- eat a Magma Shard: +6
book.lavagenesis.journal.mass.3:
- rest in lava near your home vent and the hotspot wells up into you, more every stage
- offer gifts at your vent: +10 each
- new land raised by eruptions feeds you too
book.lavagenesis.journal.offering.hotspo: Craft it: two each of Pele's Tear, Volcanic Glass, Sulfur Crystal and Olivine around a magma block.
book.lavagenesis.journal.offering.magma_: Break Molten Rock in your chamber, or lava that has only just begun to cool. Shards are good to eat, too: +6 mass.
book.lavagenesis.journal.offering.olivin: Mine Olivine Ore in the walls of your volcano and on the sea floor. Lava that cools deep underwater sometimes turns to olivine.
book.lavagenesis.journal.offering.peles_: When your lava cools in the open air above the sea, escaping gas sometimes flings out a glassy drop. Listen for the chime.
book.lavagenesis.journal.offering.sulfur: Fumaroles steam on fresh land under the open sky. Sulfur clusters grow on top: harvest them fully grown.
book.lavagenesis.journal.offering.volcan: Break Glassy Basalt: black glass made where lava is quenched by the sea or by the waves.
book.lavagenesis.journal.offerings.1: Some stages demand a gift. Carry it to your home vent and use it on the vent. Each gift counts toward the next stage and feeds you +10 mass.
book.lavagenesis.journal.pressure.1: Pressure is the force behind your powers. Every eruption spends it, and it builds again by itself - faster in lava and close to your vent.
book.lavagenesis.journal.pressure.2: Each stage wakes a new power. Choose one and unleash it. Small at first, your powers grow until they can raise whole islands from the sea.

book.lavagenesis.journal.stage.start: Where every volcano begins. Melt, drink and grow.
book.lavagenesis.journal.stage.vent: a home vent bound to you
book.lavagenesis.journal.stages.1:
From spark to Great Volcano you will wear nine bodies. The pages that follow name each one and what it asks of you.

When all is met, the hotspot surges and you grow.
book.lavagenesis.journal.subtitle: kept by the fire beneath the sea
book.lavagenesis.journal.tips.1:
- While small, never stray far from lava.
- Rain is cold: shelter, or stay in the fire.
- Your home vent warms you, feeds you and brings you back if you fall.
book.lavagenesis.journal.tips.2:
- Islands rise best from the shallows: build up from the sea floor where the water is not too deep.
- The checklist on your panel shows what the next stage still needs.
book.lavagenesis.journal.tips.3:
- Lost this journal? Craft another from a book and a lump of coal or charcoal.
- Every stage also brings a gift to your body. Read the chat when you grow.
